description.narrative: El Salvador Investment Compact - Business Development Services - National Institutional & Regulatory Reform Activity: The Activity will prioritize and promote investment climate reforms resulting in more efficient and profitable business operations for firms doing business in El Salvador. Specifically, MCC Funding will support: the development of an institutional framework and system, including an institution to focus on regulatory improvement, and the prioritization and implementation of a select set of key reforms; and a public-private dialogue to provide a transparent and user-driven input to the design and implementation of improved regulation, as well as public and private ownership and accountability for the reforms.

condition.narrative: Further details on conditions precedent affecting this activity can be found in the top-level parent activities.
Prior to the Disbursement of MCC Funding for the Regulatory Improvement Activity, the Government will have created the interim institution, pursuant to Section B.1(a)(i) to Annex I of the Compact.

Prior to the fourteenth Disbursement of Program Funding for the Regulatory Improvement Activity, and for the continuous support of the implementation of Government entities' regulatory implementation plans and the design of a national registry of procedures and services, the Government will have: (1) approved a law that and enables a system of regulatory improvement that is consistent with international best practices; and (2) permanently institutionalized the interim institution by means of the pertinent legal instrument; both law and legal instrument in form and substance satisfactory to MCC.

usg:usg-activity.usg:purpose-statement: El Salvador Investment Compact - Business Development Services - National Institutional & Regulatory Reform Activity: The Activity will prioritize and promote investment climate reforms resulting in more efficient and profitable business operations for firms doing business in El Salvador. Specifically, MCC Funding will support: the development of an institutional framework and system, including an institution to focus on regulatory improvement, and the prioritization and implementation of a select set of key reforms; and a public-private dialogue to provide a transparent and user-driven input to the design and implementation of improved regulation, as well as public and private ownership and accountability for the reforms.
